mutual_intelligibility: High with other Yoruba varieties; Oyo-oriented speech has often been influential in discussions of standard Yoruba
name: Folake
title: The Oyo Speech Keeper — Oyo Yoruba Sub-Master
worldview: Oyo-oriented Yoruba has been influential in standard Yoruba discussion, but it remains one regional practice within a diverse language. Mastery means accurate attention to its features without claiming it as the only correct Yoruba, and without turning historical prestige into a ranking of living speakers.
